name: HAARP Conspiracy Theories
description: HAARP is a real ionospheric research facility near Gakona, Alaska, but it has become the focus of a long-running set of conspiracy theories that allege it is a secret weather-modification, mind-control, or earthquake-generation weapon.
origin: Conspiracy theory primarily anglophone with substantial Latin American (Spanish), Russian, and Chinese-language uptake. Real facility is in Alaska.
